# Components CI skips because they are known not to build or pass on main yet,
# typically mid-way through a cross-cutting upgrade (e.g. a LEZ bump that has
# reached the programs but not the module FFIs).
#
# One component per line, with a reason after `#`:
#   module:amm  # LEZ v0.4 port pending (#123)
#
# Components: program:<name>, module:<name>, app:<name>, integration, benchmark,
# tools, lez-core-version. scripts/ci-plan.py rejects unknown names.
# Remove the line in the PR that fixes the component, so CI checks it again.

program:ata                   # LEZ actor-model port pending
program:stablecoin            # LEZ actor-model port pending
program:token_mint_authority  # LEZ actor-model port pending
module:amm                    # LEZ actor-model port pending
module:oracle                 # LEZ actor-model port pending
module:stablecoin             # LEZ actor-model port pending
module:token                  # LEZ actor-model port pending
